achievements.hint:
True ending (be aware this one spoils other endings)
Have more good hearts than bad hearts with Agne. Just keep loving her and if you have the pink sticker, then you're set. Just be sure to select the pink sticker choice at the end.
Keep making the Sugar Mommy happy. You'll know you're deep down in the sugar if you get the lollipop sticker.
Get to the money goal. You can do this with the sugar mommy or by working at the mall with the fast food outfit.
Don't fulfill any ending criteria (Be broke and waste time).
Have more bad hearts than good hearts. Alternatively, don't commit to loving Agne too much.

Have your Hygiene meter reach 0.
You can get this pretty quickly by using the trait "Slob" and selecting "Do It" followed by "Swallow Money" until you're dead.
On Week 8, Outside -> Sleuth -> Break In -> Follow the Ants -> 3rd option (Keep eyes shut).
